node.title: E1 square-mass-18 cofactor-514 energy-twelve all-unit exclusion
node.closure: parity-split relation cap and cubic Hermite norm majorant
node.statement: Exact local parity forces an odd number of odd lags in the all-unit energy-twelve profile. Splitting signed cubic relations into EEE and EOO types gives M3<=510, and a global cubic Hermite majorant puts every such norm below the prize field floor. Eleven magnitude profiles remain.
node.notes: ANALYTIC REFINEMENT 2026-07-29: parity-split additive counting closes the former all-unit boundary without lag enumeration. The five-ideal occupancy threshold remains open on eleven rows at E=5,...,11.
